sections.heading: Introduction
content: Guardians of the Future places great importance on protecting your personal data and privacy. This Privacy Policy explains what personal data we collect when you use the Platform, for what purpose and on what legal basis we process it, how we store and protect it, and what rights you have in relation to that processing.

Personal data is processed in accordance with the United Kingdom's data protection regime (UK GDPR), the European Union's General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), and all other applicable data protection legislation.
By using the Platform, you confirm that you have read this Privacy Policy and acknowledge that your personal data will be processed as described in it.

sections.heading: How We Use Personal Data
content: We use personal data for the following purposes:

items: Informing you about updates and important notices
Responding to enquiries and support requests
Protecting users and maintaining the security of the Platform

trailingContent: We do not sell personal data to third parties, and we never make it public.

sections.heading: Legal Bases for Processing
content: We process personal data on one or more of the following legal bases:

items: Consent – where you voluntarily provide information or consent to specific processing activities.
Legitimate interest – to operate, improve and secure the Platform, and to support volunteer participation.
Contractual necessity – where processing is required to provide the services users request.
Legal obligation – where processing is required by applicable law.

sections.heading: Data Retention
content: We retain personal data only for as long as necessary for the following purposes:

items: Data for active accounts is retained while the account remains active.
Inactive accounts may be deleted after 12 months of inactivity.
Legal and safeguarding records may be retained for longer where required by law.

sections.heading: Your Rights Under the GDPR
content: Within the limits of applicable law, you have the right to:

items: Access – request a copy of your personal data.
Rectification – request correction of inaccurate data.
Erasure – request deletion of your personal data.
Restriction – request that processing be restricted.
Data portability – request your data in a structured format.
Object – object to processing based on legitimate interest.
Withdraw consent – withdraw your consent at any time where processing is based on it.

trailingContent: To exercise your rights, please contact us.

sections.heading: Protection of Children's Data
content: The Platform is intended for adults. Where minors take part in using the Platform, parental or legal guardian consent may be required in accordance with applicable law. Where minors or vulnerable persons are involved, we apply additional safeguarding measures.

sections.heading: Complaints
content: If you believe your personal data has been processed unlawfully, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the competent supervisory authority.
In the European Union, you may contact your National Data Protection Authority.
In the United Kingdom, complaints may be directed to the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO).

sections.heading: Changes to This Privacy Policy
content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be published on the Platform with an updated date. Continued use of the Platform after publication constitutes acceptance of the updated Policy.
